svg.title: Selected historical DWTS forecast comparisons
svg.desc: Paired differences in mean log loss on 86 outer-validation eliminations across 12 seasons. Dots are candidate minus named baseline; lines are 95% whole-season bootstrap intervals from 20,000 draws. Negative values favor the candidate. All three intervals cross zero. Two-feature choice versus current-score model: -0.0374 [-0.0980, +0.0174]. Selected fixed-share versus fixed online mixture: +0.0046 [-0.0065, +0.0198]. Selected tempered versus fixed online mixture: -0.0023 [-0.0150, +0.0086]. Exploratory historical evidence conditional on fitted predictions; refitting, selection and repeated-exploration uncertainty are excluded. This is not independent prospective validation.
